messages:
alex: Planning to cut SDK release (py 1.12.0, ts 2.4.0) at 16:00 PT in the change window. Need final green from integration + npm/pypi publish. @maria can you run preflight?

maria: running preflight now. will post results.

deploy-bot: preflight-checks: py-integration: FAIL (timeout on e2e-auth) | ts-integration: PASS | docs-build: PASS

maria: py e2e failing reproducer:
```
AssertionError: token refresh timed out after 30s
  at tests/auth_test.py:42
```

sam: ugh. looks like a flaky token endpoint in staging. I can run a local fix (increase timeout) but that's a test hack. Recommend hold publish for py and proceed with TS only? we should avoid splitting releases across languages.

irene: i'd prefer we don't ship TS alone unless we bump minor and call it out in release notes. Also need to update deprecation section for legacy sync client v0.x in both.

maria: suggestion: shadow-publish py/ts to `npm:shadow` / internal pypi index and run full integration matrix. If stable after 4h, promote to latest. Anyone object?

sam: +1. that allows downstream CI to exercise without changing public tags.

deploy-bot: shadow-publish job started: job_id=shad-8432. monitoring logs.

qa: noted. we'll run the nightly regression against shadow tag and report in thread.

release-bot: if we hold, please prepare a short changelog snippet to include "publish delayed due to staging auth flake; shadow release created: shad-8432".

ops-bot: rollback playbook ready: `./scripts/rollback-sdk.sh --to 1.11.8` (ops only). ping @oncall if promote required.

alex: OK action items: 1) shadow publish started (maria) 2) qa run (qa) 3) write temporary deprecation blurb (irene) 4) don't tag `latest` yet. We'll reconvene in 45m. :thumbsup:

maria: logs: py shadow upload succeeded (wheel+sdist), ts shadow tag published. kicking integration matrix.

qa: regression green on shadow after fixes. two small lint warnings in ts, non-blocking.

alex: reconvene: decision to promote after we confirm infra auth flake fixed in staging. if no recurrence in 2h, promote. if recurrence, we'll revert shadow and hold release. update release notes accordingly.

irene: I'll squash deprecation text into release notes and PR draft ready. sharing link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/389

sam: noted. adding pinned-version instructions to docs for enterprise customers: `pip install redwood-sdk==1.11.8` / `npm install @redwood/sdk@2.3.7`

release-bot: promotion window scheduled at +2h if no failures detected (watch job shad-8432)

alex: thanks everyone. I'll post a short announcement in #general once promoted.
